common.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

language.screenNote: This sets the language of this console. The language SETU speaks to beneficiaries on calls is set separately, inside the console.
language.hint: You can change this later from any console, without signing out.
language.interfaceDialogNote: This changes the language of this console only. It does not change what SETU speaks to beneficiaries.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: For departmental staff only. Beneficiaries do not sign in — they reach SETU by phone.
login.panelBody: Sign in with your official credentials. SETU reads your role and opens the right console — no menu to navigate.
login.panelBodySecondary: Every entry you make here reaches someone who cannot read this screen. Skilling by voice, in ten languages, for anyone with a phone.
login.keepSignedIn: Keep me signed in on this device
login.routedNote: You will be routed to your console automatically based on your assigned role.
login.legal: Unauthorised access to this system is an offence under the Information Technology Act, 2000.
login.resetSent: If {{email}} has a SETU account, a password reset link has been sent to it.
login.resetNeedsEmail: Enter your official email first, then choose “Forgot password?”.

errors.invalidEmail: That is not a valid email address.
errors.userDisabled: This account has been disabled in Firebase Authentication.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the sign-in service. Check your connection.

access.noConsoleBody: You are signed in as {{email}}, but this account has no SETU role. An administrator needs to create its record in the users collection.
access.inactiveBody: The account {{email}} has been deactivated by an administrator. Contact your administrator to restore access.
access.errorHint: If this mentions missing or insufficient permissions, check that the Firestore security rules are published and that your users record exists.

detection.agreedNote: Both detectors named the same language, so the call continues in it.
detection.contestedNote: The two detectors named different languages. In testing that meant the caller speaks something Bhashini does not support, so the call was logged as a dialect gap.
detection.unconfirmedNote: Only one detector answered, so the result could not be cross-checked.
detection.synthesisCaveat: Agreement was measured on synthesised audio; real recordings are still needed.

voice.title: Beneficiary call
voice.empty: Press Start call. SETU greets in Hindi and English, then listens — hold the button to speak, or type instead if the microphone misbehaves.
voice.typedPlaceholder: Or type the reply and press Enter
voice.detectionPending: Detection runs on the caller's first reply, using both models.

outcome.completed: Completed — in the executive's completed calls

mic.deniedBody: Allow microphone access in the browser's address bar, or type the reply instead — the whole call works by typing.
mic.unavailableBody: This browser cannot reach a microphone. Type the reply instead — the whole call works by typing.

notice.not-heard: SETU could not make out that reply. Say it again, or type it.
notice.detection-failed: Language detection could not be reached. The call continues in Hindi.
notice.audio-unreadable: That recording could not be read. Try again, or type the reply.

voice.rehearsalContested: Rehearsal mode: detection is forced to contested (Hindi 0.92 against Maithili 0.98, the values the two models returned for Magahi speech in testing). Remove ?rehearse=contested for the live path.
voice.demoSubtitle: The call as a beneficiary experiences it, run here so it can be shown from inside the consoles.
voice.demoNote: This demonstrates the beneficiary’s call experience. In production a beneficiary reaches SETU by phone on the toll-free number and never sees this interface — it exists so the call can be shown on a screen.
